title: Session 2: Interactive Report
text:
Interactive Ozone and Temperature Plot
See Figure 1 for the results


Code
p <- ggplot(airquality, aes(x = Temp, y = Ozone, color = factor(Month))) +
 geom_point(size = 2, alpha = 0.8) +
 labs(
   x = "Temperature (°F)",
   y = "Ozone (ppb)",
   color = "Month"
   ) +
  theme_minimal()

ggplotly(p)








Figure 1: Interactive daily ozone concentration vs. temperature in New York.
